{{Top|leg}}
'''Tashelin Industries''' was a manufacturing company that was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The company also sent out [[Probe droid/Legends|probes]], and one such probe was sabotaged by a corporate rival so that it crashed while exploring the [[Meligin Asteroid Belt]]. Tashelin Industries offered a high reward for the retrieval of the droid's [[Datacore/Legends|datacore]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Missing probes}}</ref>
